note: THE BIG WIN, by design: anims.js exists to retarget Quaternius UAL2 clips onto an arbitrary rig with a different bind pose, and ~273 of its 408 lines (SCHEMES/mapBones/buildRig/retarget/sampleQ/bindPose/skeletonOf/the per-body `rigs` cache, anims.js:97-369) are EXACTLY what Unity's Humanoid Avatar system already does, for free, for banana/eggplant/toad (18/18 landmarks, measured) — counted as covered per this port's brief, with the reasoning spelled out in the class header rather than asserted. DIRECTLY PORTED (~44 lines): the clip-metadata loader and lookups (loadMoves/moveInfo/moveNames -> Load/Info/NamesByTag, anims.js:62-95) and canTakeMoves (anims.js:399-408), now simply 'is this one of the 3 humanoid bodies' (CharacterRoster.IsHumanoidBody) since Unity's own retarget either applies wholesale or not at all — there is no body-by-body rig measurement left to do. NOT PORTED / OUT OF SCOPE: a Generic-rig retargeter for the elephant. The elephant is 0/18 humanoid landmarks (measured) — Unity's Humanoid system does not apply to it at all, so it gets none of this library's climb/vault/slide/melee clips, same as anims.js's own retarget() returning null for 'a body with no thighs to measure.' This is a scope cut stated plainly, not an oversight: nothing in the 4-body roster's quality bar asks the elephant to climb, and building a bespoke retargeter to serve exactly one Generic rig was not worth it here.

note: Full port: per-foot height tracking against CONTACT_H/LIFT_H, the crouch/walk/run/sprint gait classifier, the half-second-cached ground-surface raycast (with the tunnel-bore-floor short-circuit and the 'skip anything above the hero's own feet' filter), the cadence fallback for a body with no feet to read, and Land()'s double-foot thud. Ground CLASS (bare earth/grass/water) reuses Assets/Scripts/Data/TerrainSampler.ClassAt (verified, per the coordinator's update) instead of re-deriving it. Structural surface CLASSIFICATION reuses Assets/Scripts/Combat/Ballistics.cs's SurfaceClassifier.Classify, which is already a verbatim port of src/ballistics.js's classifySurface (the exact function footsteps.js:3 imports) — passing World=null falls through to the material-name heuristics exactly as the JS does with no `world`. The actual SOUND reuses Assets/Scripts/Core/AudioFx.cs's FxAudio.Footstep/Landing, already a line-for-line port of src/audiofx.js's footstep()/landing() (gait gain/rate tables included) by a different agent — this file only resolves which ROLE string to hand it (footsteps.js:28-32's ROLE table, copied verbatim). ONE NATIVE REPLACEMENT: footsteps.js:67-71's hand-rolled 'nearby collidables' broadphase (w.collidablesNear) is replaced by Physics.RaycastAll against a LayerMask — Unity's own spatial index, which Three.js never had. Foot bones come from CharacterRig.LegPair(), not a private rig lookup, since footsteps.js:97 already called straight into characters.js's _legPair() rather than owning that logic itself.
